title: Un peu — beginner French
description: Beginner words, phrases, numbers and être/avoir forms. Nouns include articles. Adjectives use masculine singular unless noted. Examples are optional. IDs remain stable for saved progress.

cards.exEn: Thank you and see you soon!
Goodbye and have a good day!

cards.ex: J'ai soif. Je voudrais de l'eau.
cards.exEn: I'm thirsty. I'd like some water.
The train station is on the left.
I'm trying to find my way.
Thank you, have a good day!

cards.ex: La réunion commence à neuf heures.
cards.exEn: The meeting starts at nine o'clock.

cards.ex: Parlez plus lentement, s'il vous plaît.
Je commence le travail à neuf heures.
cards.exEn: I start work at nine o'clock.

cards.ex: J'apprends le français petit à petit.
cards.exEn: I'm learning French little by little.

cards.ex: À tout à l'heure, après la réunion !
cards.exEn: See you later, after the meeting!
